owner_report_verbatim: Hard to tell what is truly unused with crazy taxi 2 because when I hit the button combo it first went back to the main menu. Jet grind radio worked

jet_grind_radio.route: combined module, leaf variable-root admission (fa54fdc3aa0f, carried unchanged into e4cc4914bc6a)
jet_grind_radio.result: Owner reports it worked; the test asked for a save, a relaunch and a load on the virtual A2 card.

crazy_taxi_2.exit: A+B+X+Y+Start returned to the game menu first; a second press reached the RET screen, as the test sheet describes. Bits only ever clear during a session, so the menu round trip can only add used pages.
crazy_taxi_2.not_measured: 0x8ce00000-0x8ce3ffff (the stage) and 0x8cfe0000-0x8cffffff (its stack page) were never marked; pages below 0x8c180000 hold the executable

static_cross_check.used_pages_match_code: Page 0x8ce80000-0x8cedffff is used in both sessions; the executable names fixed buffers at 0x8ce90000, 0x8ce98000, 0x8cea0000 and 0x8ceb8000.
static_cross_check.free_interval: No PC-relative load in the executable reads an aligned word inside 0x8cee0000-0x8cfdffff. The aligned values in that range sit in data tables (0x8c117b90-0x8c11b958, pairs of 16-bit identifiers such as 0x0cf3001f) or are odd, and no instruction loads them.
static_cross_check.soft_reset: No code reaches the entry, the C start or main except the startup itself; data tables name the entry address only.
